From: Marketing Manager [Your name], Subject line: Revisits - Simplify the Review Cycle, Sent Date:

To: The Cross-team Committee On Revisions 

CC’d To Relevant Managers And Co-leader Teams,

Hello Cross-team,

To streamline workflow within the department while maintaining thorough review cycles, we’re introducing some refinaments for our revisit protocol.

Essays and projects requiring multiple drafts are now due one full week before scheduled re-evasions (from previous timeline: three full weeks from submission), with an aim to balance timely revisions and detailed scrutiny by our review committee. For immediate projects or time-sensitive pieces (i,e, urgent client pitches or last-second campaign materials needing final tweaks) this window can still stretch out up-to three to five weeks.

This update ensures timely turnaround of feedback for revisions while still adherinng the importance placed
